inclusivePhaseCheck.scope: Per-request sum of occurrences of a named inclusive span, on requests where present; not additive across phases or independent percentiles.

clockBracket.meaning: Host-before/after bracket around a DB clock_timestamp read. This estimates clock offset uncertainty; it does not synchronize clocks or justify comparing raw cross-clock timestamps as exact order.
clockBracket.revocation_order: Use matching DB commit/revision and authoritative read on the DB clock plus host request-after-ack causal ordering. Preserve both clocks.

limitations: No isolated server SQL CPU attribution: SQL spans include driver/wire/execution/decoding/scheduling.
